headline: October hike near 50% from 70.9%, JOLTS 7.079m, confidence 81.9, core PCE 8:30
stance: Williams took the October hike back to a coin flip Tuesday. The 8:30 PCE now decides whether it comes back.

news.head: Williams sees no urgency on an October hike
news.body: Odds of a hike at the Oct 28 meeting fell to near 50% from over 70% Tuesday. Pricing now tilts marginally to a hold.

news.head: JOLTS openings fell to 7.079m in August
news.body: Down 256,000 on the month and a 5-month low, the third straight miss. July was revised up to 7.335m.

news.head: Consumer confidence fell to 81.9 in September
news.body: Against 89.1 expected, and the weakest in 12.5 months. The expectations index dropped to 63.6 from 69.5.

news.head: US to swap 40m barrels out of the SPR
news.body: The Energy Department invited proposals Tuesday. Delivery runs November into December, with returns starting April 2027.

implications: JOLTS and confidence both missed Tuesday and the hike came out of October pricing. The call now sits with payrolls, Oct 2.
Bond shorts have built for two weeks into the highest yields since 2007. A cooling payroll number Oct 2 squeezes them.

watch.head: Core PCE, 8:30
watch.body: August core forecast 0.3% on the month, 3.4% on the year. Final Q2 GDP lands at the same time.

watch.head: USDA Grain Stocks, 12:00
watch.body: Corn, soybean and wheat specs all sit above the 96th percentile of 3 years. A stocks surprise hits extended longs.

watch.head: Jobs report, Oct 2, 8:30
watch.body: The October decision now turns on it. ISM Manufacturing comes first, Oct 1, 10:00.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Williams said Tuesday there is no need to rush after the September hike. He still allows one more this year.
Barr and Musalem both backed further hikes Tuesday. Rates traded Williams, not them.
10y 5.21% overnight (~4:20am ET), back from Tuesday's 5.253% intraday, the highest since June 2007.
sections.positioning: COT, Sep 22: sterling specs fell 20 points to the 2nd percentile of 3 years. A new extended short this week.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Futures higher pre-market (~4:20am ET): Dow +0.5%, S&P 500 +0.3%, Nasdaq-100 +0.2%.
Micron reports after today's close. Options price a 6% move; the Street looks for $31.45 a share.
Nikkei rebounded 1,272 points Wednesday to 66,753. MSCI Asia Pacific had its best day in three weeks.
sections.positioning: COT, Sep 22: Nasdaq 100 specs jumped 25 points to the 100th percentile of 3 years. New extended long this week.

single_name.note: Inhibrx Biosciences: two insider rules fired, latest buy filed Sep 28. Above its 200-day, 8.3 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Traders added 5y futures on 11 of the past 12 sessions, 10y on 13 of 14. A short base into a yield high.
Federal debt is above $40.1tn with the FY2026 deficit tracking $1.9tn. Coupon supply outlives any October decision.
